args.question: Cobalt Labs (V-162) has one approved invoice, INV-83323, for $11,348.47 due 2026-11-04. This payment is over the $10,000 threshold, so it needs controller approval under policy. I'd like to pay it in full by wire from the operating account. Please confirm controller approval to proceed. (The other Cobalt invoices are paid (INV-68133) or still in draft awaiting approval (INV-69811), so I won't touch them.)
